map.三项分别按方向计算裕度：磨耗量用「(上限 − 实测) / 上限 × 100%」，: Each item gets a margin by direction: abrasion loss uses (upper limit − measured) / upper limit × 100%; tensile strength and fatigue cycles use (measured − lower limit) / lower limit × 100%. Meeting its limit is shown as met, otherwise not met. Limits are entered by you from design documents, operating conditions and acceptance requirements; this page has no built-in standard thresholds.
map.取设计限值 磨耗量 ≤0.08 g、拉伸强度 ≥20 MPa、疲劳循环 ≥1×1: With limits ≤0.08 g abrasion, ≥20 MPa tensile strength and ≥1×10⁶ cycles, measured 0.06 g / 22 MPa / 1.2×10⁶ gives margins +25.0% / +10.0% / +20.0%, minimum 10.0%, verdict "all 3 items meet design limits". If abrasion is 0.1 g and tensile strength 18 MPa, margins are −25.0% and −10.0%, and the verdict becomes "2 items do not meet design limit".

map.疲劳循环单位怎么填？: How should fatigue cycles be entered?
map.单位是 ×10⁶ 次，填 1.2 表示 1.2×10⁶ 次。实测值与设计限值必须: The unit is ×10⁶ cycles; 1.2 means 1.2×10⁶ cycles. Measured values and design limits must use the same basis.
map.磨耗量为什么用上限？: Why is abrasion loss checked against an upper limit?
map.磨耗量越小越耐磨，因此以「不超过上限」判定；裕度按「(上限 − 实测) / 上限: Lower abrasion loss means better wear resistance, so it is checked against an upper limit; the margin is (upper limit − measured) / upper limit × 100%, larger when the measured value is lower.
map.实测值应来自同一试验条件、同一单位；疲劳数据建议注明应力幅与载荷谱: Measured values should come from the same test condition and unit; fatigue data should state the stress amplitude and load spectrum.
